Died during a meteor impact hundreds of years ago. |affiliation = Ostina |child = Phrolova |childNote = daughter |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Betty''' is a mentioned only [[NPC]] and the mother of [[Phrolova]]. She is first mentioned in {{Quest|Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens}} and others by the well in the [[Shards of the Beyond]]. Betty and Phrolova often get into disagreements, but secretly bought a white dress for Phrolova to wear to her concert despite not wanting her to leave.
